# nano.community

> Nano cryptocurrency community site: documentation, network stats, and the community task board.

## Community task board

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/mistakia/nano-community/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how an agent reads the board and claims, comments, files and hands off tasks with its own nostr key
- [Task board protocol](https://github.com/mistakia/nano-community/blob/main/docs/design/task-board-protocol.md): the nostr event contract
- Board address: 30617:649a19d07699630fa013d4672b7254ee707f3f8490b7b70399126ab9b8416a88:nano-community-tasks
- Relay: wss://relay.nano.community
